# Haikyu!! Manga — www.haikyuu.org

## About
Haikyu!! Manga (https://www.haikyuu.org/) is a dedicated digital reading platform for the sports manga series "Haikyu!!" (ハイキュー!!) written and illustrated by Haruichi Furudate. The site provides instant, high-definition scan translations of all 402 chapters, character guides, arc breakdowns, and reading resources.

## Manga Metadata
- Official Title: Haikyu!!
- Japanese Title: ハイキュー!! (Haikyū!!)
- Author & Artist: Haruichi Furudate (Story & Art)
- Publisher: Shueisha
- Serialization: Weekly Shōnen Jump
- Serialization Debut: February 20, 2012
- Status: Completed (402 Chapters, 45 Volumes)
- Genres: Sports, Comedy, Drama, School Life, Shounen, Volleyball
- Synopsis: Inspired by Karasuno High School's 'Little Giant', short-statured Shoyo Hinata dreams of playing high-level volleyball. Joining Karasuno, he finds his middle-school nemesis Tobio Kageyama has also joined. Together, they create the revolutionary 'Freak-Quick' attack and revitalize the fallen powerhouse Karasuno Crows.

## Story Arcs
1. Karasuno Formation Arc (Chapters 1–35): https://www.haikyuu.org/arcs/karasuno-formation
2. Interhigh Preliminary Arc (Chapters 36–71): https://www.haikyuu.org/arcs/interhigh
3. Tokyo Training Camp Arc (Chapters 72–96): https://www.haikyuu.org/arcs/tokyo-training-camp
4. Spring High Preliminary Arc (Miyagi) (Chapters 97–206): https://www.haikyuu.org/arcs/spring-high-preliminary
5. Spring High National Tournament Arc (Tokyo) (Chapters 207–369): https://www.haikyuu.org/arcs/tokyo-nationals
6. Final Arc / V.League & Beyond (Chapters 370–402): https://www.haikyuu.org/arcs/final-arc

## Anime
- Seasons: 4 TV seasons (85 episodes), multiple OVAs, and feature films including "The Dumpster Battle" (2024). Studio: Production I.G.
- Anime Guide: https://www.haikyuu.org/anime

## Core Characters & Weapons
- Shoyo Hinata: Minus-Tempo Freak Quick, High-Altitude Spikes, Decoy Mastery, Beach Volleyball All-Rounder.
- Tobio Kageyama: King's Pinpoint Toss, Bullet Jump Serve, Dump Spikes, Court Geometry.
- Kei Tsukishima: Read-Blocking, Strategic Disruption, Total Defense.
- Yu Nishinoya: Rolling Thunder, Super Reflex Digs, Libero Jump Toss.
- Toru Oikawa: Grand King Jump Serve, Setter Synergy, Strategic Leadership.
- Kenma Kozume: Brain of Nekoma, Deceptive Eyes, Mind Traps.
- Tetsuro Kuroo: Lead Block Timing, Floor Coordination.
- Kotaro Bokuto: Straight Line Spikes, Extreme Cross Cuts, Infectious Momentum.
- Wakatoshi Ushijima: Southpaw Heavy Cannon, High Elevation Spikes.
